verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser is built API-first. Its core capabilities are documented as programmatic: cloud sessions with CDP WebSocket endpoints, stealth, CAPTCHA solving, profiles, proxies and recordings, plus the Scrape, Crawl, Extract and Fetch APIs and agent tasks started with a single API call. These are exposed through official SDKs, an `hx` CLI and an official MCP server. missing for 10: an explicit statement of API/UI parity, evidence that dashboard functions such as account, API-key, billing/credit and usage management are available via the API, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
